crossRefs.note: Moses brought out all the rods from before Yahweh to all the children of Israel. They looked, and each man took his rod.

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

people.name: Moses
people.line: Prophet who led Israel out of Egypt

translations.web: Moses brought out all the rods from before Yahweh to all the children of Israel. They looked, and each man took his rod.
translations.bsb: Then Moses brought out all the staffs from the LORD’s presence to all the Israelites. They saw them, and each man took his own staff.
translations.kjv: And Moses brought out all the rods from before the LORD unto all the children of Israel: and they looked, and took every man his rod.
translations.asv: And Moses brought out all the rods from before Jehovah unto all the children of Israel: and they looked, and took every man his rod.
